name: Nu Me Hair & Beauty
description: A relaxed, light-filled hair and beauty salon in Mount Barker, specialising in vivid color, lived-in blondes, and cuts that feel like a brand new you.

hero.title: Step in. Leave a new you.
hero.subtitle: Vivid color, soft blondes, and tailored cuts in a calm, welcoming space in Mount Barker — book your visit today.

stylists.name: Owner
stylists.title: Founder & Lead Stylist
stylists.bio: Founder of Nu Me Hair & Beauty and a lover of bold, vivid color, she built a calm, supportive salon where every client walks out feeling like a brand new version of themselves.

reviews.name: Jess T.
reviews.text: Absolutely in love with my rainbow color! So vibrant and my hair still feels soft and healthy. The salon is so calm and beautiful too.

reviews.name: Megan L.
reviews.text: Finally found my go-to salon in Mount Barker. My balayage is exactly what I asked for and the whole experience was so relaxing.

reviews.name: Chloe R.
reviews.text: Friendly, professional, and genuinely talented. I left feeling like a new me — the name says it all!

reviews.name: Sarah W.
reviews.text: Brought my daughter in for her first proper haircut and she loved it. Such a welcoming, supportive space.
